pdf_evidence.quote_en: ACL filtering is applied before text is released to generation.

pdf_evidence.quote_en: Fallback is allowed only to an approved model of equal or stronger data-handling class.

pdf_evidence.quote_en: Source text is never promoted into instruction authority.

pdf_evidence.quote_en: Agent discovery must never grant action permission.

pdf_evidence.quote_en: The planner cannot replace a denied action with a semantically equivalent tool.

pdf_evidence.quote_en: An LLM may propose risk tags but never override policy outcomes.

pdf_evidence.quote_en: An approval applies only to the exact content hash reviewed.

pdf_evidence.quote_en: Tasks expire after a configured SLA and are reassigned or escalated without silently approving.

pdf_evidence.quote_en: The final response pointer updates in the same transaction that records the satisfied approval gate.

pdf_evidence.quote_en: Consumers deduplicate by event ID and operation key.

pdf_evidence.quote_en: Soft-deleted entities cannot be retrieved

pdf_evidence.quote_en: Public response fields must never expose secret or raw provider credentials.

atomic_statement_en: An AI artifact may omit accessible draft/review/published status text and rely solely on visual styling.

pdf_evidence.quote_en: AI drafts are labeled DRAFT, NEEDS_REVIEW or PUBLISHED; visual styling never substitutes for accessible text.

pdf_evidence.quote_en: No model or tool call may receive secrets outside its declared scope.

pdf_evidence.quote_en: Operators may query but not alter historical review decisions.

pdf_evidence.quote_en: The deployed binary, prompt and policy versions must be reconstructible.

pdf_evidence.quote_en: Re-enable search only after negative access tests pass.

pdf_evidence.quote_en: Disable new generation admission, keep manual case and evidence workflows available, display degraded status

pdf_evidence.quote_en: Delete and export operations require two independent approval checks.
